description: Hyperbolic volumes used by the MostowRigidity class instances in the encounter chapter.  Vol(4_1) computed via the Clausen-function identity at 50 decimal digits (Vol(4_1) = 2 · Cl_2(pi/3)); Vol(5_2) is a 15-dps literature constant (Adams–Hildebrand–Weeks 1991, SnapPy verified).  Source of truth for the Lean literals MostowRigidity.figureEight.volume / .mostow_gap and MostowRigidity.knot5_2.volume via the :leanval[vol_4_1], :leanval[vol_5_2], :leanval[mostow_gap_4_1] tags.

data.gap_note: gap_lower_bound is a conservative under-approximation of Vol(5_2) - Vol(4_1); see gap_5_2_minus_4_1_15 for the computed value at 15 dps.  Once SnapPy is in CI, both vol_5_2_decimal_15 and gap_5_2_minus_4_1_15 should be regenerated at 50 dps with a SnapPy-verified hyperbolic structure.
